rows.definition: Environment switch that supplies the default result-elision byte threshold when no positive explicit threshold is configured.
rows.distinction: FeatureUncachedTrim names the ablation mechanism; this environment variable configures its default threshold and does not prove that a request used it.

rows.definition: Serve feature catalog identifier for the deterministic mock-planner configuration and its evaluated enablement state.
rows.distinction: MockPlanner is the executable offline planner; FeatureMockPlanner is the catalog key describing whether that planner is configured or installed.

rows.definition: Serve runtime field retaining detected Strix appliance capabilities for gateway configuration and hardware-derived feature provenance.
rows.distinction: DispatchPreflight admits a worker launch; strixPreflight records serving-host detection and does not grant dispatch or tool-call permission.
